## How it works

- [statement] Aster's volume, and so any volume-based liquidity ranking of its listings, has been disputed. DefiLlama co-founder 0xngmi announced the delisting of Aster's perp volume data on October 5, 2025 after detecting volumes that mirrored Binance's nearly 1:1, and the analytics platform could not access maker and taker order information from Aster to verify whether wash trading occurred. A DefiLlama adapter commit dated 15 Oct 2025 (aster keep realistic volume wrt OI) sets daily volume to 0 when it is 25 billion or more. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-22) — https://finance.yahoo.com/news/defillama-delist-aster-volume-data-101345708.html · keywords: Altcoin perp listing coverage across zero-fee venues · also: https://github.com/DefiLlama/dimension-adapters/commit/93d747c23261e1b4b64ff67ad4a54b7b47b59dce, https://castlelabs.io/research/perp-dex-rankings/aster, https://coinpaprika.com/education/perp-dex

## Measurements and reference values

- [statement] Thin perps are fragile. On November 16 the ASTER token fell by roughly 32% (from about $0.71 to about $0.48), with about $9.16 million of liquidations, 65% of them longs, per CoinGlass data cited by CryptoPotato. Aster's CEO confirmed an internal investigation and denied any market-maker arrangement; the trader theory of a perp-market distortion spilling into spot prices remains unconfirmed. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-16) — https://www.kcex.com/news/148260 · keywords: Altcoin perp listing coverage across zero-fee venues

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] Aster's AOS-2 docs describe an application route to a perp listing: stake 200,000 ASTER locked for 4 years (returned on rejection), hold a token listed on Binance Alpha or a Tier 2 exchange with at least $10,000,000 circulating market cap, name a designated market-maker wallet already connected to Aster, pass an on-chain validator vote, then Aster's Risk team configures leverage brackets and open interest caps and the market goes live T+1 at 3× initial leverage. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-22) — https://docs.asterdex.com/aster-open-standards/aos-2-perpetual-listing · keywords: Altcoin perp listing coverage across zero-fee venues · also: https://finance.biggo.com/news/aab2ce3f-6278-4c28-8785-9d81254b43b9

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] Listing counts increasingly reflect RWA rather than altcoins. one RWA-perps guide's timeline says that on 11 September 2026 perpetual DEXs passed 1,000 listed RWA markets, 747 of them individual shares; Castle Labs reports RWA perps reached $147.5 billion of volume in July 2026, 19.6% of all onchain perp volume; and CoinGecko, citing DefiLlama data, says Variational grew from 6 to over 119 TradFi markets between May and September. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-19) — https://www.bit.com/knowledge-hub/rwa-perps · keywords: Altcoin perp listing coverage across zero-fee venues · also: https://castlelabs.io/research/reports/mapping-the-perpetual-trading-ecosystem, https://www.coingecko.com/learn/best-perp-dexes-and-on-chain-trading-platforms

## Facts and statements

- [statement] Hyperliquid's long-tail growth runs through HIP-3: a deployer meeting the staking requirement of 500k HYPE (maintained for a minimum of 183 days after the dex is deployed) can deploy one perp dex with independent margining, order books and deployer settings. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-22) — https://hyperliquid.gitbook.io/hyperliquid-docs/hyperliquid-improvement-proposals-hips/hip-3-builder-deployed-perpetuals · keywords: Altcoin perp listing coverage across zero-fee venues · also: https://crypto.news/hyperliquid-hip-3-and-hip-4-explained/, https://www.talos.com/insights/state-of-the-network-368
- [statement] Hyperliquid's HIP-3 requires a deployer to hold 500k HYPE staked (maintained for a minimum of 183 days after the dex is deployed) to deploy one perp dex with independent margining and order books. The first 3 assets deployed in any perp dex need no auction participation; additional assets go through a Dutch auction. A deployer can settle an asset with the `haltTrading` action at the current mark price and reuse it, and once all assets are settled the required stake is free to be unstaked. Validators can slash a deployer's stake for malicious market operation. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-22) — https://hyperliquid.gitbook.io/hyperliquid-docs/hyperliquid-improvement-proposals-hips/hip-3-builder-deployed-perpetuals · keywords: Altcoin perp listing coverage across zero-fee venues · also: https://coinpaprika.com/education/perp-dex, https://castlelabs.io/research/reports/mapping-the-perpetual-trading-ecosystem
- [statement] Lighter's announcements feed shows plain 'New Perp Listing' headings (including $BE, $AVGO and $GME) next to 'New RWA Perp Listings', and delistings of $FOGO, $EDEN, $DOLO, $RESOLV and $MYX (September 22) and $PROVE and $EDGE (October 28), with open perp positions settled at the mark price. Pyth describes Lighter as expanding perpetual markets beyond crypto into equities and other real-world assets.
